name: Ferienwohnung Juffinger Georg
beschreibung: The Ferienwohnung Juffinger Georg is located in the quiet village of Thiersee in Tirol, surrounded by the impressive mountain scenery of the Alpen. The idyllic surroundings with forests and meadows invite you to take long walks. The apartment is modernly furnished and offers a balcony with a view of the greenery. Guests appreciate the quiet atmosphere that makes for a relaxing stay. Nearby, numerous hiking and cycling trails await you. The nearby Thiersee is ideal for swimming and relaxing. In winter, the ski areas of the region are easily accessible.
